# proxmox_sdn_fabrics (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN fabrics from `/cluster/sdn/fabrics/fabric`, sorted by `fabric_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_fabrics" "openfabric" {
  protocol = "openfabric"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `protocol` (String) Restrict the result to one fabric protocol. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `fabrics` (Attributes List) Matching fabrics, sorted by `fabric_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fabrics))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.

<a id="nestedatt--fabrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fabrics`

Read-Only:

- `fabric_id` (String)
- `ip_prefix` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `state` (String)
